meta.title: Negociación de
meta.goal: Puedes explorar intereses, formular condiciones, intercambiar concesiones y cerrar un acuerdo sin deteriorar la relación.

cards.title: Define límites y variables
cards.lede: Antes de negociar, distingue lo imprescindible de lo intercambiable y lo que aún necesitas descubrir.

rows.value: We cannot accept liability for third-party delays.
We would like a two-year commitment.
Price, rollout timing, and support hours can be traded.
Which outcome matters most to the other side, and why?

cards.title: Pregunta detrás de la demanda
cards.lede: Una demanda rígida puede ocultar un interés que admite varias soluciones.

columns.label: Debatir posición
examples: We can’t reduce the price by 15 percent.

columns.label: Explorar interés
examples: What would the 15 percent reduction allow you to do?
Is budget certainty more important than the unit price?

cards.title: Usa propuestas vinculadas
cards.lede: Las fórmulas if–then evitan conceder primero y negociar la compensación después.

rows.value: If you can commit to two years, we can reduce the annual rate by eight percent.
Provided that payment is made quarterly and scope remains fixed, we could include weekend support.
What flexibility would that create on your side?
A conditional offer is not yet a final commitment.

cards.title: Da valor y protege reciprocidad
cards.lede: Nombra el costo de la concesión y vincúlala a algo que permita sostener el acuerdo.

lines.text: Weekend support is difficult for us, but we could include it if the rollout remains in two phases.
That’s our final offer. Take it or leave it.
That is the furthest we can move on price; we still have flexibility on timing.

cards.title: Desbloquea sin amenazar
cards.lede: Cuando una variable se cierra, cambia el nivel de la conversación o introduce opciones equivalentes.

rows.value: It sounds as though predictability, rather than price alone, is the core concern.
Would you prefer a lower rate with fixed scope, or more flexibility at the current rate?
It may be useful for both sides to review the numbers before we continue.
I don’t want this point to obscure the value we’ve already created together.

cards.title: Confirma alcance y contingencias
cards.lede: Un “yes” bajo presión no basta: tradúcelo a obligaciones, fechas, excepciones y autoridad.

rows.value: To confirm, the rate is fixed for two years and weekend support begins after phase one.
Third-party delays remain outside the service guarantee.
This is subject to legal approval on both sides.
We’ll exchange revised language by Tuesday and flag any remaining differences.

tip.label: Principio:
tip.body: sé firme sobre límites, curioso sobre intereses y explícito sobre condiciones.

options: If you commit to two years, we can lower the annual rate.
quiz.explain: Conecta la concesión con una condición recíproca.

quiz.q: ¿Qué pregunta explora el interés detrás de una demanda?
options: What would that reduction allow you to do?
quiz.explain: Busca el resultado subyacente sin atacar la posición.
Esos elementos convierten el acuerdo verbal en un compromiso claro.
